text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Western Mariner - (built 1984) 42,239 dwt sold to Slovenian buyers for $12.2 million.
Azteca 1 - (built 1987) 38,455 dwt sold to Norwegian buyers for $12.8 million.
TANKERS - Atlantic Star - (built 1967) 7,014 dwt sold to Lebanese buyers for $9 million.
Gaz Coral - (built 1981) 6,526 dwt sold to Tunisian buyers for $7.8 million.
CONTAINERS - Kinabalu - (built 1992) 12,854 dwt sold to Korean buyers for $18.9 million.
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
